acceptance: A later authorized Naya must be able to obtain the lesson without the predecessor handing it over, recognize applicability, change behavior and leave evidence of the result.
definition: Learning is a verified change in future usable behavior or decision context.
purpose: The learning doctrine of the activation kit: the definition of learning, its lifecycle, what a learning record connects, reconciliation, and the acceptance test.
reconciliation: Check new lessons against related knowledge for duplicates, contradictions, scope differences and superseded concepts; preserve conflicts rather than hiding them.
title: INTELLIGENCE / LEARNING
